caseName: Oregon Stevedoring Co. v. Italia Societa per Azioni di Navigazione
caseNameFull: Oregon Stevedoring Co., Inc. v. Italia Societa per Azioni di Navigazione
attorneys: Floyd A. Fredrickson for petitioner. Erskine B. Wood for respondent.

opinions.text: Motion to use the record in No. 82, October Term, 1963, granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied. Mr. Justice Black is of the opinion that certiorari should be granted.
